shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: My inventory is currently balanced (1 A, 1 C, 1 B). Trading away my only A for a second B would make me have 0 A, 1 C, 2 B, which is less diversified and reduces utility given my preference for variety. I'd rather keep balance or trade to increase a good I have zero of.

Current inventory is balanced (1 A, 1 C, 1 B). Trading away my only B for another A would make me 2 A, 1 C, 0 B, which is less diverse and thus lower utility given my preference for variety. I'd rather keep balance or trade for something that increases diversity.

Trading away my only B (going to 0) to get a 3rd A would create a highly imbalanced bundle (3 A, 1 C, 0 B), which hurts my variety-based utility more than gaining a duplicate A helps. Rejecting to seek a more balanced trade instead.
